evidence: Resolves memory amplification DoS where transactions in the mempool and orphanage consumed up to ~28 bytes per weight unit.
rationale: Eliminating a 28x memory expansion vector for adversarial witness transactions in the mempool is critical for DoS defense. By storing witness elements serialized, worst-case memory usage drops from ~28 bytes/WU to 1.6 bytes/WU, allowing the mempool to hold 13-15% more transactions under load.
